notes.title: Update 20200626
notes.content:
Hello Masters, 

Summer is finally here! It’s about time to change your character outfit into a “cooler” swimsuit!

The following is the main content of this update and fix. Hope you have fun! 
1. Fix the issue of custom button change and the button issue around skill upgrade that doesn’t dynamically change the Settings buttons. Also, dynamic change button function is added for better user experience.
2. Fix the issue around the menu interface in the battle that opens the custom interface, and the issue that exits the custom interface when pressing B to exit the custom interface.  
3. Fix the issue that it closes the store page when opening the Settings menu in the battle. Also fix the bug that causes the interface issue on the Settings menu when the store page is on. 
4. Fix the issue that the green cursor in the character select screen disappears when a button is pressed during the loading screen. 
5. Fix the issue that the announcement screen is overlapping when using a controller in the Settings menu.
6. Fix the fade-in and fade-out animation issue.
7. Allow custom options for blocking.
8. Fix the issue in the character screen. When a user is in the character screen and select to display the skills of the character and presses B button to exit, then go back to the character screen again, the screen to display character skills remains without being selected.
9. Add an option to close the store page when the user died. Fix the controller issue when opening store page after reviving.
10. Fix the controller issue when returning to the main menu after joining a password protected room.
11. Fix the issue that causes cancellation when pressing R button too many times.
12. Fix the issue that causes controller malfunction when calling up announcement screen by pressing X button in the Settings menu.
13. Remove the timer and the arrow on the top of the screen in the Story mode.
14. Fix the bug that causes the controller to not function as intended in a private password protected room.
15. Fix the bug when player 2 joins player 1’s room, player 2 can still create a room by using a controller. 
16. Fix the issue that causes the countdown not to work as intended in the multiplayer Guardian mode.
17. Added more difference the “Leave room” interface between using a controller and keyboard. 
18. Fix the bug that causes the sound effects not to work as intended when character is standing on the edges.
19. Modify the backpack item list logic. Fix the issue that the controller can still select items outside the sliding area. 
20. Fix the positioning issue when moving items from backpack to Scroll View.
21. Fix the overlapping issue of the backpack and the result screen in the Guardian mode.
22. Fix the bug that causes the display error in the Guardian mode.
23. Fix the bug that causes the backpack item prompt being blocked by a statue. 
24. Interface terminology usage change from “back” to “quit” and to “save and exit”.
25. Fix the issue in the Guardian mode that causes the Settings menu to overlap with the result screen. 
26. Fix the issue in the Guardian mode that causes the information screen to overlap with the HP bar. 
27. Change the button prompt in the mode select screen.
28. Fix the issue that loses the select highlight when changing from cursor/keyboard to controller.

notes.title: Update: Bug fixed
notes.content:
Dear Masters,

The epidemic situation has finally calmed down a little. I hope you all can take good care of yourselves during this difficult time.

Whilst the new content is still being developed, this update mainly addresses some issues that people have experienced for a long time.

[b]The main fixes of this update include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some UI display bugs
[*] Fixed the UI to hide the HUB function (while playing with a keyboard)
[*] Fixed avatar overlapping or wrong character display
[*] Optimized the character interface while playing with a controller 
[*] Fixed the issue that the controller doesn’t function as it should
[*] Fixed the issue that if the operation is too fast the camera in the lobby will not function properly
[*] Fixed the issue that two skins of MuRong YuQin classroom model are too large
[*] Fixed the He RuoLin swimsuit animation lag issue
[*] Fixed Liu MuYing's skills delayed issue
[*] Fixed problems when saving your play data
[*] Fixed data upload issue
[*] Fixed some other minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Free DLC#1: The Summer Memory of The College
notes.content:
It's about the time backing to school now and it also means the end of Summer.

Let's guess what our masters do in this Summer?!

Hummm...(They all say that they have a busy summer. Ocean? Girls? Swimsuit?! Where are they?! )

Well ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

The only way to make this Summer perfect is making it into the DLC!

So, Here it is. At the end of Summer, [b]We finished our First FREE DLC for Zengeon Fans! In the coming 5 weeks, You will get a swimsuit skin update each week![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153360/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34246564/4e71193b2a0a8b101dcd77fc8b96a57ce441c6a9.png[/img]

First Swimsuit for this week: [b]Hou Shuyan[/b]!

Unlock this swimsuit, you need to pass the difficult mode(Single Player or Multiplayer? Your choice)


We also bring you guys the updates of the game itself.

1. Adjustment for the game

Increasing the drop rate of the Story Props
Balacing the damage of CrossFire Spell/ Wind Spirit/ Thunder Bird/ Ice Spirit

1. Bug fixing 

Fix a bug that make addtional items when loading saved game.
Fix a bug that may losing saved game loss when playing others mode.
Fix a bug that can't load the items when playing the guardian mode.
Improve the experience that keep the cursor when plug in the controller.
Improve the loading speed.

Our last question is, what about your summer? Take a comment and share with us!

notes.title: 2019.01.19 Update
notes.content:
Feedbacks and updates:

[b]Player: 52pcgame[/b]
"Suggest that new people can choose Shuyan to start,  often use 2 to break away from the enemy. "
[b]Producer's Feedback[/b]:'It's really difficult for players to start by choosing a character with long forward shake without adding difficulty information. Based on this feedback, the new version adds character characteristics and difficulty information to facilitate players to choose easier characters first. "

[b]Player: Magickingdino[/b]
"Additional controller support is desirable if possible. "
[b]Producer's Feedback[/b]: "XboxOne's handle support has been added in setting page at battleground. Custom key configurations will also be added later. "

[b]Player: Magickingdino[/b]
"Hope to add on hold control."
[b]Producer's Feedback[/b]: "We added shift button/Controller button LB to hold players' position during attack.  Mouse control is more suitable for remote roles, WASD or handle operation is more suitable for melee roles. "

More suggestions are welcomed to be shown in the Steam community.Thanks!
